an6.71:1.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇituṃ sati satiāyatane
an6.71:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ime hānabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ime ṭhitibhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ime visesabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ime nibbedhabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti asakkaccakārī ca hoti asappāyakārī ca
an6.71:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇituṃ sati satiāyatane.
an6.71:2.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇituṃ sati satiāyatane

an6.71:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇituṃ sati sati āyataneti. 72
